General Dynamics is up 6.04% YTD with a P/E of 21.93 and a 'buy' analyst rating; the stock fell 6.43% in the past month, presenting a potential dip-buy opportunity in a prime defence contractor.

Booz Allen trades at a cheap P/E of 11.43 with a 3.24% dividend yield and positive news sentiment (0.077); the stock gained 2.01% in one month but is down 12.28% YTD, offering modest upside at a discount.

Red Cat has a 'strong_buy' analyst rating (score 1.38) and very high short interest of 21.86%, but the stock fell 8.62% YTD and 3.35% in the past month; a short squeeze or drone catalyst could spark a recovery.

Olin offers a 4.61% dividend yield with positive news sentiment (0.301), but the stock is down 17.24% YTD and lost 6.14% in the past month; analyst consensus is 'hold' and P/E is negative, making it a deep-value speculation.
